body: Founder: shankpit og engine is failing build on github -> pls fix. Every real CI run since build #721 (2026-06-11) had failed at 'Build Windows Client' with undefined references to cutscene_*/audio_* symbols. Root cause: the cutscene system (52e321e) and spatial audio engine (767bbe7) commits added real new source files (packages/simulation/cutscene.c, packages/audio/audio.c) that apps/lobby/src/main.c now calls into, but CI's hardcoded mingw build command was never updated -- a stale file list, not a code bug. No mingw toolchain or gh CLI/token available in this environment, so verified by reproducing the exact same build command natively with gcc instead: got the identical undefined-reference errors on the old file list, and a clean build with no errors after adding both files. Neither new file has any POSIX-only calls (confirmed via grep) so the same fix should cross-compile under mingw. Fixed identically in both release.yml and tests.yml (duplicated build command). Linux Server build step untouched -- confirmed apps/server/src/main.c never references these symbols. Pushed dd8541e/a648dec; a real CI run (#783) started automatically and was in_progress at time of filing -- not yet confirmed green.
title: CI fix: added missing cutscene.c/audio.c to Windows client build
